"I twisted it. I heard a little bit of a pop, but the doctor said that could just be the joint popping," a visibly concerned Roddick said after the match. "It’s frustrating because I felt like I was playing well. Right now, I’m just going to get it checked out, get an MRI, and hope for the best for next week."

Blake expressed sympathy for his Davis Cup teammate: "You never want to win this way, especially against a good friend. I just hope Andy is 100% by the time Wimbledon starts."

There were no such stumbles for home favorite **Andy Murray**, who put on a masterclass performance against former world No. 1 Juan Carlos Ferrero. "I served very well today and moved great," Murray told reporters. "Juan Carlos has been playing really good tennis this week, so to win in straight sets gives me a lot of confidence. To be in the final here is a huge honor—now I just want to finish the job tomorrow."

At the AEGON Classic in Birmingham, **Maria Sharapova’s** grass-court return ended in the semi-finals as China’s **Li Na** upset the former Wimbledon champion 6-4, 6-4.
